title: Weymouth New Testament in Modern Speech, 2 Thessalonians
summary: "Weymouth New Testament in Modern Speech, 2 Thessalonians" by Richard Francis Weymouth is a biblical translation published in 1903. This work represents Weymouth's attempt to express the New Testament as though its inspired writers were composing in nineteenth-century English. Based on his compilation of multiple Greek texts, the translation aims to provide a concise running commentary alongside traditional versions.
